verdict.rationale: The Department documents agents as a distinct role alongside employers and employee leasing companies: agents may file reemployment tax returns for clients and must add, delete or update client information through the e-File and e-Pay Enrollment System or a batch enrollment file. The pack also mentions an electronic certification statement shown before RT-6 submission, but it publishes no authorization or power-of-attorney forms and no list of what an agent may or may not do. Missing for 10: published third-party authorization forms, an explicit scope of permitted and prohibited agent actions, documentation of which signatures or certifications must remain the taxpayer's own, and independent corroboration.
